word-forehead.def: the part of the face between the eyes and the hair

word-eyebrow.def: the line of short hair above each eye

word-cheek.def: the soft part of the face below each eye

word-chin.def: the part of the face below the mouth

word-throat.def: the tube at the back of the mouth that leads down to the stomach and lungs

word-wrist.def: the joint between the hand and the arm

word-palm-hand.def: the flat inner side of the hand between the wrist and the fingers

word-thumb.def: the short, thick finger at the side of the hand

word-toe.def: one of the five small parts at the end of the foot

word-nail-body.def: the hard, thin plate that covers the end of a finger or toe

word-ankle.def: the joint that connects the foot to the leg

word-heel.def: the back part of the foot, below the ankle

word-hip.def: the side of the body where the leg joins the trunk

word-waist.def: the narrow part of the body between the ribs and the hips

word-buttocks.def: the two rounded parts of the body that you sit on

word-lung.def: one of the two organs in the chest that you use to breathe

word-liver.def: a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and helps digest food

word-kidney.def: one of two organs that filter waste from the blood and make urine

word-joint.def: a place where two bones meet, such as the knee or elbow

word-spine.def: the line of connected bones down the middle of the back

word-toothache.def: an aching feeling in one of your teeth

word-stomachache.def: an aching feeling in the belly

word-sore-throat.def: a painful, scratchy feeling at the back of the mouth when you swallow

word-runny-nose.def: fluid that keeps dripping from the nostrils, often when you have a cold

word-sneeze.def: to suddenly blow air out of the nose and mouth without wanting to

word-nausea.def: the unpleasant feeling that you are about to throw up

word-vomit.def: to bring food up from the stomach and out through the mouth

word-diarrhea.def: an illness with frequent, watery waste from the bowels

word-constipation.def: a condition in which it is hard to pass solid waste from the body

word-dizzy.def: feeling unsteady, as if everything around you is spinning

word-rash.def: an area of red spots or patches on the skin

word-itch.def: to give you a feeling that makes you want to scratch your skin

word-swelling.def: a part of the body that has grown bigger because of injury or illness

word-bruise.def: a dark mark on the skin where you were hit

word-wound.def: an injury where the skin is cut or torn

word-burn-injury.def: an injury to the skin caused by fire, heat or hot liquid

word-bleed.def: to lose blood from the body

word-fracture.def: a break or crack in a bone

word-sprain.def: an injury in which the tissue around a joint is stretched or torn

word-infection.def: an illness caused by germs getting into the body

word-allergy.def: a bad reaction of the body to something like pollen or a certain food

word-inflammation.def: redness, heat and swelling in a part of the body, often with pain

word-high-blood-pressure.def: a medical condition in which the heart pushes against the vessel walls too hard

word-insomnia.def: a long-term problem with falling asleep or staying asleep

word-cramp.def: a sudden, painful tightening of a muscle

word-faint.def: to suddenly lose consciousness for a short time

word-diabetes.def: a disease in which the body has too much sugar in the blood

word-asthma.def: a lung illness that makes breathing hard and causes wheezing

word-cancer.def: a serious disease in which cells grow out of control

word-depression.def: an illness that makes a person feel very sad and hopeless for a long time

word-anxiety.def: a strong feeling of worry or fear about what might happen

word-pregnancy.def: the time when a woman has a baby growing inside her

word-disability.def: a physical or mental condition that limits what a person can do

word-epidemic.def: a disease that spreads quickly to many people in an area

word-dentist.def: a doctor who looks after your teeth and gums

word-pediatrician.def: a doctor who treats babies and children

word-gynecologist.def: a doctor who treats women's reproductive health

word-surgeon.def: a doctor who performs operations on the body

word-specialist.def: a doctor who has trained in one particular area of medicine

word-family-doctor.def: a doctor you see first for common health problems

word-waiting-room.def: a room where people sit until a doctor can see them

word-prescription.def: a paper from a doctor that lets you get a certain medicine

word-syrup.def: a thick, sweet liquid medicine, often for coughs

word-drops.def: liquid medicine that you put into the eyes, ears or nose a little at a time

word-ointment.def: a soft, oily cream that you rub on sore or damaged skin

word-painkiller.def: a medicine that makes aches and hurts feel less strong

word-antibiotic.def: a medicine that kills the germs that cause some infections

word-vaccine.def: a substance given to protect the body from a disease

word-injection.def: medicine that is put into the body with a needle

word-bandage.def: a strip of cloth wrapped around an injured part of the body

word-band-aid.def: a small sticky strip for covering a small cut

word-thermometer.def: a tool that measures how hot or cold something is, such as your body

word-blood-test.def: a medical check in which a sample of your blood is examined

word-x-ray.def: a picture of the inside of the body, especially the bones

word-diagnosis.def: the decision about what illness a person has

word-treatment.def: care that a doctor gives to a sick or injured person

word-operation-surgery.def: medical treatment in which a surgeon cuts open the body

word-heal.def: to become well again after an injury or illness

word-check-up.def: a routine visit to a doctor to see if you are in good condition

word-sick-note.def: a paper from a doctor saying you are too ill to work or study

word-side-effect.def: an unwanted result of taking a medicine

word-dose.def: the amount of medicine you take at one time

word-contact-lenses.def: small curved pieces of plastic worn on the eyes to see clearly

word-wheelchair.def: a chair with large wheels for people who cannot walk easily

word-crutches.def: sticks that fit under the arms to help an injured person walk

word-patient-person.def: a person who is getting medical care from a doctor or in a hospital

word-doctor-declaration-ua.gl: deklaratsiia: Ukrainian agreement with a family doctor for free primary care

word-medical-card-ie.gl: Irish HSE card giving eligible people free GP visits and health services

word-nhs-uk.gl: Scottish public health service, mostly free when you use it; register with a GP

word-health-insurance-card-vn.gl: thẻ bảo hiểm y tế: Vietnamese health insurance card for reimbursed care
